changed.title: The mixed fraction and Gaussian fluctuations of the largest extension at the singular mixing threshold
changed.statement:
∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) →
  ∀ x : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => 6*(T k : ℝ)/Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^(D k))
    - 2*Real.log ((2 : ℝ)^(D k))) Filter.atTop (nhds x) →
  ∀ z : Option ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let mixed := layer.filter (fun U => ∀ b : Fin 2, ∃ i ∈ supp U, i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let s := (2 : ℝ)^d
  let mu := (n : ℝ)/(1+Real.sqrt (s-1))
  let host := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (spaces.filter (fun E : Submodule F W => U ≤ E)).sup (fun E => Module.finrank F E)
  let event : Finset (Submodule F W) := match z with
    | none => mixed
    | some y => mixed.filter (fun U =>
        (2*((a-host U : ℕ) : ℝ)-mu)/Real.sqrt mu ≤ y)
  (event.card : ℝ)/(layer.card : ℝ)) Filter.atTop
    (nhds ((Real.exp x/(2+Real.exp x)) * (match z with
      | none => 1
      | some y => ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Iic y)).toReal)))

changed.title: Signed boundary-pin histograms identify a hidden pair with lies within an additive constant of the ternary sphere bound
changed.statement:
∀ errors : ℕ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t →
  let T := Fin t
  let V := Option (T × Bool)
  let Pair := {p : T × T // p.1 < p.2}
  let E := Fin 3 × T
  let Mask := T → Fin 3
  let tail := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then some (e.2,false) else (none : V)
  let head := fun e : E => some (e.2,decide (e.1 ≠ 1))
  let weight := fun (g : Option Pair) (e : E) (diff : Bool) =>
    if e.1 = 0 then diff.toNat else if e.1 = 2 then 1 else
    if g.elim false (fun p => decide (p.val.1 = e.2 ∨ p.val.2 = e.2)) then
      (if diff then 1 else 3) else (2 : ℕ)
  let obs := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ i : T, p i = 0 ∨ p i = (if x (some (i,false)) then 2 else 1)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : E => x (tail e) ≠ x (head e))).card = 2*t then
      ∏ e : E, weight g e (xor (x (tail e)) (x (head e))) else 0
  let raw := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    g.elim (0 : Fin 3) (fun e => if p e.val.1 = 0 ∨ p e.val.2 = 0 then 0
      else if p e.val.1 = p e.val.2 then 1 else 2)
  let answer := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    if obs g p = obs none p then (0 : Fin 3) else if obs none p < obs g p then 1 else 2
  (∀ (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask), answer g p = raw g p ∧
    4*obs g p = (if raw g p = 0 then 4 else if raw g p = 1 then 5 else 3)*obs none p) ∧
  ∀ (pool : Finset (Option Pair)) (budget : Option Pair → ℕ),
    (∀ g ∈ pool, budget g ≤ errors) →
    let feasible := fun d : ℕ =>
      ∃ (ask : (i : Fin d) → (Fin i.val → Fin 3) → Mask)
        (out : (Fin d → Fin 3) → Option Pair),
        ∀ g ∈ pool, ∀ transcript : Fin d → Fin 3,
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin d => transcript i ≠ answer g
            (ask i (fun j => transcript (j.castLE (Nat.le_of_lt i.isLt)))))).card ≤ budget g →
          out transcript = g
    let volume := fun (d : ℕ) => ∑ g ∈ pool,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (budget g+1), 2^j * d.choose j
    ∀ d : ℕ, (feasible d → volume d ≤ 3^d) ∧ (volume d ≤ 3^d → feasible (d+C))

changed.statement:
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let frame := fun xs : List Bool => xs.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
let field := fun (k z : Nat) => (List.range (k.log2+1)).map (fun i => z.testBit i)
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ write read residue : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast read ∧ fast residue ∧
  ∀ (n : Nat), 0 < n → ∀ A : Fin n → Fin n → Bool,
    let v := 2*n
    let e := fun h : Nat => 2*(n+h)
    let q := fun h : Nat => 2*e h+1
    let cells := (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange n).map (fun j => (i,j)))
    let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Nat := fun i j => (A i j).toNat
    let mat := cells.toFinset.powerset.filter (fun S =>
      (∀ z ∈ S, A z.1 z.2 = true) ∧ (S.image Prod.fst).card = S.card ∧
      (S.image Prod.snd).card = S.card)
    let m := fun r : Nat => (mat.filter (fun S => S.card = r)).card
    let I := fun j : Nat => Nat.card {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin j) // Function.Involutive P}
    let links := fun h : Nat =>
      let port := fun (block j : Nat) => block*q h +
        (if j = 0 then 0 else if j = e h+1 then 2*e h else 2*j-1)
      cells.flatMap (fun z =>
        let l := port z.1.val (2*z.2.val)
        let l' := port z.1.val (2*z.2.val+1)
        let r := port (n+z.2.val) (2*z.1.val)
        let r' := port (n+z.2.val) (2*z.1.val+1)
        if A z.1 z.2 then [(l,r),(l',r')] else [(l,l'),(r,r')]) ++
      (List.range v).flatMap (fun u => (List.range (h+1)).map (fun j =>
        (port u (2*n+2*j),port u (2*n+2*j+1))))
    let size := fun h : Nat => v*q h+2*(links h).length
    let rows := fun h : Nat =>
      (List.range v).flatMap (fun u => (List.range (e h)).map (fun j =>
        let b := u*q h+2*j
        [b,b+1,b+2])) ++ (links h).zipIdx.flatMap (fun z =>
          let b := v*q h+2*z.2
          [[b,b+1,z.1.1],[b,b+1,z.1.2]])
    let Z := fun h : Nat => let k := size h
      let Fn := (Fin k → Bool) → (Fin k → Bool) → Bool
      Nat.card {f : Fn // (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k ∧
        PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin k => decide (i=j)) C ∧
        ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
        ∀ R ∈ rows h, f (fun i => decide (i.val ∈ R)) (fun _ => false) = true}
    (∀ h : Nat, write (header n ++ header h ++ cells.map (fun z => A z.1 z.2)) =
      header (size h) ++ (rows h).flatMap (fun R => R.flatMap (field (size h))) ∧
      ((rows h).map List.toFinset).Nodup ∧
      (∀ R ∈ rows h, R.length = 3 ∧ R.Nodup ∧ ∀ u ∈ R, u < size h) ∧
      (∀ u : Fin (size h), ((rows h).filter (fun R => decide (u.val ∈ R))).length = 2) ∧
      0 < Z h ∧ Z h = (Finset.range (n+1)).sum (fun r =>
        4^r*m r*(q h)^(2*n-2*r)*I (2*n-2*r))) ∧
    read (header n ++ (List.range (n+1)).flatMap (fun h => frame (Z h).bits)) = B.permanent.bits ∧
    ∀ d : Nat, 1 < d → Odd d →
      let h := (4*n+1)*(d^2-1)/4
      q h = (4*n+1)*d^2 ∧
      Z h % (d^2) = (4^n*B.permanent) % (d^2) ∧
      residue (header n ++ header d ++ (Z h % (d^2)).bits) = (B.permanent % (d^2)).bits

changed.title: A binary address tree in equality and crown fitting has sharp adaptive probe depth, fixed probe count and unit observation count at every height
changed.statement:
let pairs := fun n : Nat => (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i =>
  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
∀ (h : Nat) (crown : Bool),
  let N := 2^(h+1)-1
  let k := 2*N+6
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  let probe := fun f : Fn => (pairs k).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let vs := (pairs k).toFinset
  let block := fun (e : Fin k × Fin k) (j : Nat) => e.1.val = 2*j ∧ e.2.val = 2*j+1
  let blocks := vs.filter (fun e => ∃ j < N, block e j)
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ probe f ⊆ blocks
  let value := fun (f : Fn) (j : Nat) => decide (∃ e ∈ probe f, block e j)
  let target := fun f : Fn =>
    let leaf := (List.range h).foldl (fun j _ => 2*j+1+(if value f j then 1 else 0)) 0
    if value f leaf then (1 : Int) else 0
  let Rows := List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)
  let score := fun (L : Rows) (f : Fn) => (L.filter (fun r => decide (f r.1.1 r.1.2 = r.2))).length
  let realizes := fun L : Rows => ∃ b : Int, ∀ f : Fn, fits f → (score L f : Int) = b + target f
  let strong := fun I : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => ∀ K ⊆ I,
    ∃ (b : Int) (w : Fin k × Fin k → Int), ∀ f : Fn, fits f → probe f ∩ I = K →
      target f = b + ((probe f) \ I).sum w
  let adap := fun d : Nat =>
    ∃ (ask : Nat → Fin k × Fin k) (b : Nat → Int) (w : Nat → (Fin k × Fin k) → Int),
      ∀ f : Fn, fits f →
        let j := (List.range d).foldl (fun u _ => 2*u+1+(if ask u ∈ probe f then 1 else 0)) 0
        target f = b j + (probe f).sum (w j)
  (∀ S ⊆ blocks, ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ probe f = S) ∧
  (∃ L : Rows, L.length = 3^h ∧ (∀ r ∈ L, ∀ j, r.1.2 j = false) ∧
    ∀ f : Fn, fits f → (score L f : Int) = (((3^h-1)/2 : Nat) : Int) + target f) ∧
  (∀ L : Rows, realizes L → 3^h ≤ L.length) ∧
  adap h ∧ (∀ d, adap d → h ≤ d) ∧
  (∃ I ⊆ vs, strong I ∧ I.card = 2^h-1) ∧ (∀ I ⊆ vs, strong I → 2^h-1 ≤ I.card)

changed.statement:

let pairs := fun k : Nat => (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i =>

∃ (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (c : Nat), (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (hard : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)))
    (soft : List ((Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool)),
  let m := soft.length
  let ends := fun e : Fin n × Fin n => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin n))
  let E := (pairs n).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    ∀ z ∈ hard, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))
  let lists := fun (S : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (t : (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool) =>
    Disjoint t.1.1 t.1.2 ∧ ∀ e ∈ S, ends e ⊆ t.1.1 ∨ ends e ⊆ t.1.2
  (∀ S ⊆ E, 2 ≤ S.card →
    (∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, e ≠ f → Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)) →
    (soft.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length =
      (soft.filter (fun t => !t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R T : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ T))
  let valid := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    ∀ z ∈ hard, obs f z.1 z.2 = false

  let size := fun f : Fn => ((code f).filter id).length
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (obs f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let bank := fun B : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ B))
  let input := header n ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2) ++
    header m ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => bank t.1.1 ++ bank t.1.2 ++ [t.2])
  ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k →
    let x := header k ++ input
    let count := fun s j : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // valid f ∧ size f = s ∧ score f = j}
    let output := (List.range (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s =>
      (List.range (m+1)).flatMap (fun j => bits k (count s j % 2^k)))
    Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (x.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
